rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This Spotify MCP server provides OAuth-authenticated access to the Spotify Web API, enabling AI assistants to interact with user music libraries, playback controls, and discovery features. Built with TypeScript and organized into modular tool categories (albums, artists, tracks, playlists, playback, user, search), it offers comprehensive functionality including managing liked songs, controlling playback across devices, creating and modifying playlists, searching music catalogs, and accessing user listening history and recommendations. The implementation uses Zod schemas for input validation and includes proper error handling for API interactions, making it valuable for building music-focused AI workflows, automated playlist curation, and voice-controlled music experiences.
